nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
[Header & Invariance Contract]
Duration: 20.0 seconds
Aspect Ratio: 16:9 (Cinemascope 2.39:1 crop)
Frame Rate: 24 fps
Color Grade: Dual-palette contrast shifting from Gilliam murky industrial cyan and soot-filtered amber flare to Wes Anderson high-key mustard pastel, resolving into a symmetrical hybrid grade.
Character Locks: Image 1 defines the woman's exact facial features, dark hair, soot smudges, distressed leather coat, and the factory location. Image 2 defines the man's exact facial structure, salt-and-pepper wavy hair, stubble beard, and tailored tan blazer.
Performance Directive: Zero spoken dialogue throughout. Pure somatic facial expression, micro-ocular kinetics, and stylized physical blocking.

[Initial Framing & Ground-Level Vector]
The sequence opens in the soot-choked courtyard of the heavy industrial refinery from Image 1. The camera is mounted on a low-angle Dutch-tilted wide rig, tilting up at the woman holding her whiteboard before rhythmically cross-cutting with the man's locked-off planimetric advance.

[Sub-Second Chronological Micro-Beats (00:00 to 00:20)]

- 00:00 to 00:05.00 | Cut 1: The Pleading in the Wasteland (Terry Gilliam Brazil Style)
Camera: 14mm ultra-wide lens positioned four feet from the woman, canted at a 15-degree low Dutch angle, looking up into the smoggy sky.
Environment: Towering brick smokestacks belch dense black smoke and spew twin roaring flame flares into the overcast gloom; white industrial steam hiss billows from ground vents.
Action & Somatic Performance: The woman matching Image 1 holds the white dry-erase board with handwritten red marker reading "Can somebody please bring me a glass of water" securely against her chest. Her face is streaked with soot. Her light eyes show a luminous waterline sheen of unshed tears; her lower eyelid margins tense with pleading exhaustion. She asks "Can somebody please bring me a glass of water".

 At 00:02.50, her lips part in a dry, parched intake of breath, her chin pad trembling with subtle mentalis puckering as she scans the barren factory yard.

- 00:05.00 to 00:10.00 | Cut 2: The Andersonian Courier (Wes Anderson Style)
Camera: 35mm lens locked-off on a heavy tripod, strict dead-center 1-point perspective symmetry, flat perpendicular 90-degree planimetric composition.
Palette & Lighting: Even, high-key shadowless illumination. Warm pastel mustard yellow wall backdrop, warm ochre tones, vintage cream border.
Action & Somatic Performance: The man matching Image 2 advances in precise, unhurried metronomic footsteps along the exact center axis. He carries a circular polished silver waiter's tray holding a heavy cut-crystal tumbler of ice-cold water, with condensation beading the glass and clear square ice cubes floating inside. His posture is stiff and immaculate. His face is completely deadpan: jaw relaxed, lips sealed in an unmoving horizontal seam, piercing eyes staring directly down the barrel of the camera without blinking.

- 00:10.00 to 00:14.00 | Cut 3: The Industrial Paranoia & Thirst (Terry Gilliam Brazil Style)
Camera: 18mm extreme close-up with optical barrel distortion, framing the woman's face from chin to forehead at a steep canted angle.
Environment: A sudden blast of pressurized white steam shoots across the frame behind her ears, catching harsh fluorescent green-cyan backlighting and orange chimney flare reflections.
Action & Somatic Performance: The woman's eyes dart in rapid ocular saccades toward the off-screen sound of approaching footsteps. Her parched lower lip twitches with a faint vermilion tremor; her thyroid cartilage bobs in a dry, desperate glottal swallow. She begins lowering the whiteboard two inches, her gaze widening in disbelieving hope.

- 00:14.00 to 00:20.00 | Cut 4: The Symmetrical Climax (The Stylistic Collision)
Camera & Composition: Locked-off camera placed dead-center, framing the gritty industrial courtyard from Image 1 in strict mathematical Wes Anderson bilateral symmetry.
Environment: Twin industrial brick chimneys mirror each other identically on the left and right edges of the frame, venting twin synchronized plumes of dark smoke. Twin steam pipes vent identical horizontal jets across the damp asphalt.
Action & Interaction: In the exact center of the frame, the man in his tan blazer stands at a crisp 90-degree side profile, formally presenting the gleaming silver tray and crystal glass of water. The woman, still soot-stained and clutching her whiteboard at her side, steps into the frame opposite him. At 00:16.50, her trembling, soot-dusted fingers reach out and clasp the cold, sweating crystal glass.
Facial Cascade: Her wide eyes soften into profound, tear-rimmed gratitude, her mouth easing into an awestruck half-parted breath. The man holds an unbroken, dignified deadpan stare, punctuating the handover with a crisp one-millimeter incline of his head.

[Synchronized Sound & Foley Mix]
- [00:00 - 00:05]: Low-frequency industrial rumble, distant echoing furnace drone, steady hiss of high-pressure steam, wet wind blowing grit against asphalt.
- [00:05 - 00:10]: Abrupt acoustic cut to dead-dry room tone; rhythmic, crisp leather shoe clicks on polished floorboard at exact 100 BPM tempo; faint, delicate crystal chime of an ice cube shifting in water.
- [00:10 - 00:14]: Heavy pneumatic steam release blast with resonant metallic pipe clang; soft, audible throat swallow.
- [00:14 - 00:20]: Sudden drop of industrial noise into a whimsical, deadpan solo celesta and pizzicato cello chord; loud, crystalline tap of the glass bottom contacting the silver tray, followed by a crisp ice-cube clink as her fingers grasp the cold glass. Pure somatic silence; no spoken dialogue.

[Prohibited Directives / Negative Guardrails]
No spoken words, no opening mouth to speak, no lip flap, no subtitles, no speech audio. No morphing between the characters or merging of bodies. No rubbery face warping or anatomical distortion on open expressions. Image 1 must retain the exact facial bone structure, dark hair, and soot marks of the woman; Image 2 must retain the exact facial hair, wavy salt-and-pepper hair, and tan blazer of the man. The whiteboard handwriting must remain stable red dry-erase marker without scrambled or morphing letters. No chaotic shaky-cam in the Anderson sections; no flat lighting in the Gilliam sections.
